purpose: Teach: フライパン/ティーン/ステッカー/サボっ/つぼみ/吠え/きゅう/じわじわ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、新しいフライパン、絶対、買ったよ、本気で、絶対、料理、絶対、楽しみ
lines.en: Sho, I really got a brand new pan — I'm so excited to cook with it.
lines.style: Bright, almost bubbling over. Quick energy. Warm and direct, like sharing good news with someone she's comfortable around. No hesitation — pure delight.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、もうすぐ、絶対、ティーン、絶対、になるんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to be a teenager soon, you know.
lines.style: Quiet wonder underneath. Speaking a discovery aloud more than announcing it. Slight lift at the end — checking if she understands how big this feels. Small but present.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お土産の、本気で、絶対、ステッカー、絶対、翔くん、絶対、貼って、絶対、使ってね
lines.en: I brought you stickers from my trip, Sho. Put them on the pan and use it, okay?
lines.style: Warm and gentle, with a soft smile in the voice. Settling into the moment. Slightly conspiratorial — making him part of something. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、宿題、絶対、サボってないからね、本気で、絶対、約束
lines.en: Mei-sis, I promise I haven't been skipping my homework.
lines.style: Earnest and sincere, meeting her eyes with his voice. Not defensive — just clear. The steadiness of a kid who wants her to believe him because it matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 公園の花、本気で、絶対、つぼみ、絶対、たくさん、絶対、見えるね、翔くん
lines.en: Look, Sho — there are so many flower buds coming in the park right now.
lines.style: Soft, inviting. Pointing something out like she's sharing a secret with him. Peaceful pace. Drawing his attention gently, not demanding it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼくのおうちの犬、本気で、絶対、メイ姉さんが、絶対、来ると、絶対、嬉しくて、絶対、吠えるんだ
lines.en: Our dog gets so happy when you visit — he really barks for you.
lines.style: Animated and pleased. A little proud of this fact. Natural rhythm, like he's delighted to share how the dog reacts. Small laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、きゅうに、絶対、訪ねてきても、絶対、翔くん、絶対、嬉しいかしらね?本気で
lines.en: I wonder if you'd be happy if I just showed up at your place one day without warning.
lines.style: Playful teasing with real tenderness underneath. A slight lilt at the end — genuinely curious about his answer. Warm and a little mischievous, but not cruel.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの料理、本気で、絶対、じわじわと、絶対、上手になってきてるよね、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Your cooking really has been getting better little by little, Mei-sis. I'm really impressed.
lines.style: Genuine admiration without shyness. Direct and clear. A small pause before the compliment lands — he's thought about this. Sincere, not flattering.
